summary: Endurance athlete in Limassol: gravel cycling first, then running, hiking and the occasional open-water swim. Tracked with a Garmin Forerunner 965 and Strava (figures as of 12 Oct 2026).

activities.description: The main sport: gravel rides around Limassol and Akrotiri, longer road and MTB rides when travelling. 611 rides and about 11,500 km since joining Strava; longest ride 87.5 km, biggest climb 780 m.
Short, regular runs in the Mediterranean heat plus trail runs in the hills. All-time 79 runs and 348 km; personal bests 5K in 24:30 and 10K in 57:12.
Long walks and hill hikes, especially in summer trips to the Balkans: several hikes of 9–12 km with 200+ minutes on the trail.
Only sometimes: short open-water swims in the Mediterranean, nothing regular.

philosophy: Don't wait for motivation. Motivation waits for those who are already running.
